task: Check structural trait method argument typing before a generic function is concretely specialized.
observation: Java previously checked trait method arity and used the declared result type, but did not compare call arguments with the trait method parameter types while checking a generic body. An uninstantiated invalid body passing Bool to a Float parameter was accepted by Java and rejected by C++ with TYPE_MISMATCH. Java now checks each trait method argument against the declared trait signature.
impact: The checker rejects this invalid generic body even when no concrete call instantiates it. A focused Java test also preserves acceptance of a well-typed generic function with two calls to the same trait method; C++ currently false-rejects that valid source with TYPE_AMBIGUOUS_OPEN_RESULT, as independently confirmed by the Architect.

resolution.summary: Java generic-body trait argument checking now matches the C++ rejection for the minimal invalid case. The independent C++ repeated-member false rejection and broader per-call member facts remain open.
